seoTitle: CCSD Calendar 2025-2026: Clark County Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: CCSD 2025-2026 calendar with Aug 11 first day, May 22 last day, staff development days, Thanksgiving, winter break, spring break, PDF and ICS.
heroSummary: CCSD observes Nevada Day and Family Day and schedules an elementary-only parent-teacher conference day. November 26, April 3, and May 26 are reserved as Contingency Days if additional instructional time is needed.
calendarNotes: Clark County School District lists 180 student days for 2025-2026. Classes begin on August 11, 2025 and the school year ends on May 22, 2026. Winter Break begins at the end of the day on December 19, with no school December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026; classes resume January 5, 2026. Spring Break begins at the end of the day on March 13, with no school March 16-20 and classes resuming March 23. The calendar also lists staff development days, an elementary-only parent-teacher conference day, and contingency days on November 26, April 3, and May 26 if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CCSD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Clark County School District starts classes on Monday, August 11, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCSD Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break begins at the end of the day on December 19, 2025. No school is scheduled December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCSD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break begins at the end of the day on March 13, 2026. No school is scheduled March 16-20, and classes resume March 23.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CCSD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Friday, May 22, 2026.
